fact_previews: SimpleCompliance is a project aimed at protecting individuals from workplace violence, harassment, and danger.
Michael Rosenberg is the creator of SimpleCompliance.
The project was launched on Kickstarter.
The funding goal for SimpleCompliance was $3,530.
The funding period for SimpleCompliance was from September 28, 2016, to October 28, 2016.

fact_previews: In Ontario, individuals have the right to an independent investigation of a complaint of harassment by a trained professional as per Bill 132.
Many definitions of workplace violence include suspected domestic violence.
Organizations can be held liable for not conducting a yearly risk assessment.
SIMPLE COMPLIANCE software provides organizations with a comprehensive risk assessment, e-learning system, and incident reporting app.
The SIMPLE COMPLIANCE software is monitored by an independent third party and held on secure external servers.

Investigation reports will be secured to prevent changes once an investigator has submitted them.
